text: The neighbourhood of Long Branch has a rich history that needs to be protected and preserved. In the early 1900's, the neighbourhood was known as Pine Beach, boasting fifty foot lots and an abundance of trees. In recent years, this neighbourhood is being targeted as a site for lot splitting. Usually, a severance will include a plan to injure or remove if not one, but several mature trees. Trees that are protected by Tree Protection Zones (TPZ) during the construction of these homes, often succumb to their injuries and are ultimately removed, diminishing the tree canopy of Long Branch even further. I share the concern of the Long Branch community that present levels of protection (TPZ) and enforcement are insufficient to preserve the current mature trees and achieve the City of Toronto's goal of increasing the tree canopy to 47%.
